title: Account Review Templates Configurator
body:
Purpose:
This working doc introduces a modular, storyboard-based set of QBR deck templates and a lightweight renewal tracker for both standard and enterprise accounts. The goal: give CSMs a fast way to assemble tailored decks (15–30 slides) that balance executive narrative, product usage signals, and a clear renewal ask.

Principles and constraints:
- Build in blocks: each slide is a reusable content block (title, intent, data needs, talking points).
- Two lanes: Standard (PM/SM-led accounts, 20–40k ARR) and Enterprise (multi-stakeholder, SLA/contract details).
- Timebox decks to 30 minutes of presentation + 15 minutes Q&A.
- Make the renewal ask explicit (RACI-style next steps slide).
- Keep one appendix slide per technical artifact (logs, runbooks, region details) for enterprise.

Template overview (block list) — shorthand names and usage guidance:
1) Cover & Objective (1 slide) — single-sentence meeting objective, date, attendees, renewal window. Use concise customer logo and account owner. (Standard: include AM; Enterprise: list procurement/legal contacts.)

2) Executive TL;DR (1 slide) — 3 bullets: health headline, renewal posture (green/amber/red), top ask. Keep for exec sponsors.

3) Agenda & Desired Outcomes (1 slide) — 4 bullets max. Map agenda items to decisions we want.

4) Health Snapshot (1–2 slides) — composite of health signals: adoption index, uptime SLA, support cases trend, NPS or CSAT. Guidance: prioritize top 3 metrics. For Enterprise include incident SLA breaches and remediation status.

5) Usage & Outcomes (2 slides) — product usage charts, example success stories or saved time. Include cohort comparison to similar accounts. Enterprise variant: add multi-team adoption breakdown and a quote from an exec sponsor.

6) Cost & Value Summary (1 slide) — calc of monthly cost vs business value (savings, revenue enablement). Include a simple ROI formula and supporting numbers. Enterprise variant: include TCO considerations for private deployment or dedicated tiers.

7) Open Risks & Blockers (1 slide) — prioritized list (impact x likelihood) and mitigation owners. Use the renewal risk quadrant for accounts in review.

8) Roadmap Alignment & Product Ask (1 slide) — what product work is planned and how customer priorities map. Enterprise: include feature SLAs, pilot timelines, and technical resource commitments.

9) Success Plan & Milestones (1–2 slides) — 30/60/90 day milestones with owners and measurable targets. Include acceptance criteria for renewal.

10) Commercial Summary & Renewal Options (1 slide) — pricing options, term length, discount windows. Enterprise variant: show contract clauses, professional services scope, and legal contacts.

11) Call to Action & Next Steps (1 slide) — explicit asks, decision deadline, and point-of-contact for scheduling next steps. Include a named single owner for the renewal.

12) Appendix (multiple slides, optional) — technical health, runbook, SSO/KMS details, compliance artifacts. Keep for enterprise briefings or technical reviewers.

Slide-level guidance and speaker notes (examples):
- Health Snapshot: show 90-day and 30-day lines; call out anomalies with a red highlight and one-sentence cause. Speaker note: "We saw a spike on 12/08 due to ingestion backlog; engineering rolled a fix within 24 hours."
- Usage & Outcomes: include a small customer quote (verbatim) with attribution. Speaker note: "Quote pulled from support thread ID 9821 — permission confirmed."
- Commercial Summary: present 3 options (renew same, renew with 10% discount for 12-month, upgrade to Dedicated with X uplift). Speaker note: "Recommend option 2 for predictable cost and locking in current pricing for 12 months."

Customizing for Standard vs Enterprise (quick checklist):
- Standard: 12–18 slides, lighter technical appendix, single renewal owner, show product-led success metrics.
- Enterprise: 20–30 slides, mandatory appendix, include procurement/legal contacts, proposed SOW and PS scope, explicit SLA history and remediation records.

Renewal Tracker (lightweight CSV snippet to paste into a sheet):
account_id,account_name,renewal_window,renewal_owner,health_score,last_touch,forecast,blocking_item

Typical workflow for CSMs using these templates (recommended):
1) Pull the account snapshot from the CS dashboard and populate the Health Snapshot block.
2) Collaborate with Solutions Eng to fill the Appendix slides for enterprise deals.
3) Draft the Commercial Summary and share with AM for pricing alignment 7 days before the QBR.
4) Run a 15-minute dry run with the AM/engineer owning open blockers.
5) Post-QBR: update renewal tracker and assign follow-ups in CRM.

Design and format recommendations:
- Use 16:9 slides, bolded headlines, max 6 bullets per slide.
- Color language: green/amber/red for renewal posture; neutral grayscale for background.
- Data sources footnote on each metric slide (e.g., "source: telemetry, support-db, billing-report v1.2").

Pre-built slide snippets to copy-paste (short forms for quick decks):
- Exec TL;DR (template):
  - Health headline: "Account healthy; adoption growing 18% Q/Q."
  - Renewal posture: "Likely — target decision by 2025-03-15."
  - Top ask: "Approve 12-month renewal at current ARPU; schedule a pilot for Dedicated in May."

- Success Plan milestone row (table format):
  - Milestone | Target date | Owner | Acceptance criteria
  - "Data export automation live" | 2025-02-28 | DevOps | "<100ms latency on nightly export"

Notes on governance and handoffs:
- When a renewal is >$250k ARR or flagged as red, the CS Director must review the deck before the QBR and join the meeting.
- Any pricing concession >10% needs written approval from Sales Ops and Finance.
- Track approvals in Confluence page CONFLUENCE-CS/AccountReviewApprovals.

Open questions and follow-ups (work-in-progress):
- Add a slide template for multi-year ROI scenarios (requested by AMs).
- Feasibility of embedding a live dashboard widget in slide (product/console dependency).
- Create a slide checklist automation from the CS dashboard to pre-populate Health Snapshot.

Appendix: example slides to include for Enterprise only (short list) — runbook excerpt, incident timeline, legal clause summary (SLA credits), last 12 months spend breakout, current support plan.

Revision history:
- 2024-11-18: initial draft (Aisha)
- 2024-12-06: added renewal tracker CSV, enterprise appendix list (Liam)
- 2025-01-10: updated governance thresholds and sample speaker notes (Sofia)

If approved, next steps for rollout:
- Finalize a Google Slides master with these blocks (design: DX team).
- Build a one-click deck generator that pulls metrics from telemetry and populates the Health Snapshot (engineering backlog ticket: JIRA-CS-512).
- Run a 2-week pilot with 6 CSMs and gather feedback before org-wide launch.

End of document.
